module: Exposes the accelerations measured at the vehicle's reference node (gx, gy, gz) as well as their smoothed version (gx2, gy2, gz2). The raw values come from an FFI structure provided by the engine (obj:getSensorsFFI()) and are copied at each updateGFX. Used by the AI, ESC, post-crash braking, gauges and simulator protocols.
usage:
local ay = sensors.gy2 -- smoothed lateral acceleration
if math.abs(sensors.gx2) > 5 then print('hard braking/acceleration') end
notes: Units: the code does not specify them; the usages (postCrashBrake compares sensors.gz2 - powertrain.currentGravity to a threshold, esc.lua compares gy2 to 3) indicate m/s² (inferred from code).

Axes (inferred from usages): gx = sensor X axis (esc.lua/protocols.lua use it as lateral acceleration), gy = Y axis (esc.lua integrates it as longitudinal acceleration; ai.lua uses -gy as forward acceleration), gz = non-inertial vertical axis (sensorZnonInertial; postCrashBrake compares it to powertrain.currentGravity). The exact direction of the axes is not documented in the Lua code (inferred from usages).
gx, gy, gz are the raw values of the FFI structure (sensorX, sensorY, sensorZnonInertial). gx2/gy2/gz2 are smoothed by newTemporalSmoothingNonLinear(7).
All values are updated in updateGFX only: before the first updateGFX, ffiSensors is 0 (a number) then an FFI structure after init().
The update order relative to other modules (ai, esc...) depends on the main loop; these modules read the value from the last updateGFX.

gx.desc: Raw acceleration on the sensor X axis (ffiSensors.sensorX).

gy.desc: Raw acceleration on the sensor Y axis (ffiSensors.sensorY).

ffiSensors.desc: FFI structure returned by obj:getSensorsFFI() (fields sensorX, sensorY, sensorZnonInertial...). Is 0 before init().

init.desc: Fetches the sensors FFI structure from the engine then calls reset(). Called when the vehicle loads.

reset.desc: Resets the three temporal smoothers. Called when the vehicle is reset.

updateGFX.desc: Copies the raw accelerations from ffiSensors into gx/gy/gz and updates the smoothed values gx2/gy2/gz2. Called every graphics frame by the main loop.
